name: agent-graph-builder
description: Agent Graph Builder — visual graph authoring studio and TypeScript SDK

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-studio run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-studio run test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-sdk run test:coverage && pnpm --filter @bstockwelldev/agent-graph-studio run test:coverage
